prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: original high-fidelity desktop portfolio website design concept, one landscape image approximately 1536 by 1024. Show the actual flat webpage edge-to-edge, not a laptop, browser chrome, presentation board or device mockup.
Primary request: Design a visually exceptional, distinctive portfolio for Zohaib Haider, a full-stack AI software engineer. Concept name SIGNAL / 01. A sophisticated editorial engineering portfolio with a charcoal-black background, warm white oversize Swiss typography, tiny monospace annotations, thin separators, and a single pale acid-lime accent. A professional art director designed this page, not a generic SaaS template.
Composition: generous 65px margins, minimal top navigation ZH. at left, WORK / APPROACH / ABOUT at center, LET'S TALK arrow at right. A tiny index line 'INDEPENDENT ENGINEER / FULL STACK + AI'. Hero is asymmetrical: oversized left typography split into three lines 'Software.' 'With a mind' 'of its own.' with one italic serif word as a beautiful contrast. Below is short supporting copy 'I build intelligent products, from interface to infrastructure.' Two understated CTAs 'Explore selected work' and 'About me'. Right half: a stunning dimensional sculpture of black translucent glass layers, fine luminous lime connections and flowing particles, representing a living software architecture, curated as a museum object, subtle and tactile, not an AI brain or generic glowing orb. Around it three tiny precise captions INTERFACE / INTELLIGENCE / INFRASTRUCTURE aligned to parts. The sculpture and typography must not overlap. A lime circular interactive affordance 'EXPLORE THE SYSTEM' near the bottom of sculpture. Lower third of page visible: thin horizontal rule and '01 / SELECTED SYSTEMS' then two wide sophisticated project previews, first 'DSP / Booking & payments' with minimal product UI preview, second 'PDE / Multi-tenant operations' with minimal product UI preview. Name 'Zohaib Haider' visible in small header context. Black, off-white and pale lime only, very restrained glow, strong alignment, extraordinary typography and rich layered materials.
Constraints: an original design, crisp readable text, polished realistic web layout, no invented performance numbers or fake client logos, no walls of tech badges, no purple gradients, no generic card grid, no watermark. Prioritize composition and realistic typography over excessive text.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: original high-fidelity desktop portfolio website design concept, one landscape image approximately 1536 by 1024. Actual flat webpage edge-to-edge, no devices, browser chrome, or presentation framing.
Primary request: Create an extraordinary light-mode portfolio for Zohaib Haider, full-stack AI software engineer. Concept ATLAS / 02. It should feel like a beautifully typeset architectural monograph crossed with an interactive engineering notebook. Distinctive and confident, warm ivory paper #F2EFE7, ink-black text, electric ultramarine #254DFF accents. Fine rules, careful baseline grid, large expressive serif paired with technical monospace.
Composition: top thin ruled masthead 'ZOHAIB HAIDER' on left, 'ENGINEERING / SYSTEMS / INTELLIGENCE' center, 'LET'S BUILD ↗' right. Main hero 55% left and 45% right with plenty of breathing room. Small label 'FIELD NOTES / VOL. 01'. Stunning oversized headline on left in editorial serif: 'Complex systems.' 'Clear thinking.' Place a hand-drawn ultramarine oval or one precise annotation around 'Clear'. Small role 'Full-stack + AI software engineer' and paragraph 'From the first interaction to the last API call, I build products that work as one.' Underlined text CTA 'Open the project index ↗'. On right an artfully rendered exploded isometric software stack, like an architect's precise model: four floating thin milky glass and blue acrylic slabs, a tiny UI on top layer, interconnected blue nodes in middle, ink database cylinders bottom. Very light blueprint drafting lines and dimension marks. Sparse captions '01 Experience', '02 Intelligence', '03 Services', '04 Data'. An elegant vertical index at far right. Lower third: sharp editorial project ledger heading 'Selected work / 2026' and two horizontal ruled rows '01 DSP — Booking & payments' '02 PDE — Multi-tenant operations', each with a tasteful small rectangular product screenshot, discipline tags and arrow, no rounded card boxes. A cobalt solid rectangle used once as a small accent panel with 'IDEA → INTERFACE → INFRASTRUCTURE'.
Style: warm physical paper, impeccable publication typography, airy, visually daring yet extremely readable; bright intelligent engineering aesthetic, not corporate consulting. Text precision and hierarchy paramount.
Constraints: original design; no fabricated statistics, no fake testimonials or client marks, no purple, no generic SaaS hero, no excessive grids, no watermark. Clean web UI, not a poster.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: original high-fidelity desktop portfolio website design concept, one landscape image approximately 1536 by 1024. Show actual website flat edge-to-edge, no outer device or browser.
Primary request: Create a remarkably charming and sophisticated portfolio homepage for Zohaib Haider, a full-stack AI software engineer. Concept LITTLE LAB / 03. A handcrafted interactive miniature engineering workshop, a compelling 3D portfolio with strong accessible surrounding typography, a memorable personal world. Warm cream background, ink-brown type, terracotta, teal and butter-yellow details. High-end indie maker art direction, not childish cartoon, not pixel art.
Composition: top minimal nav 'zohaib's little lab' on left in charming serif, 'Projects / About / Contact' on right. Tiny section label 'A PLACE FOR CURIOUS SOFTWARE'. Main hero: left 40% crisp oversized serif headline 'Small lab.' 'Big possibilities.' with short readable text 'I’m Zohaib. I turn ambitious ideas into full-stack products and useful AI.' Primary dark teal button 'Explore my work ↗', small text link 'Read my story'. Right 60% a spectacular isometric cutaway miniature studio on a terracotta base with physically rendered clay, wood, ceramic and brushed aluminum materials, soft real shadows. Architectural dollhouse not an entire sprawling game: desk with softly glowing widescreen monitor showing a clean dashboard, vertical tiny server rack, a brass articulated lamp, a teal rolling chair, a small analog synthesizer-like AI inference instrument with cables, a potted plant, books and one sticky note. Sparse elegant floating clickable hotspot labels 'PRODUCTS' over monitor, 'AI EXPERIMENTS' by instrument, 'ABOUT ME' by desk notebook. No person. The studio sits organically in the cream canvas without a bounding card. Small illustrated interaction hint 'Pick an object. Find a project.' Below the hero a thin divider and 'Things I’ve built' with two clean numbered editorial project rows '01 DSP — Booking & payments' and '02 PDE — Multi-tenant operations' plus small project thumbnails. Tiny three-mode text switch 'WORK / PLAY / READ' above the model. Sufficient breathing room and impressive art direction.
Constraints: original characterful composition; website text must be crisp and professional, no fake statistics or testimonials, no copied Bruno Simon car, no purple gradients, no stock robot or generic AI brain, no dashboard wall, no watermark. The dimensional illustration must be gorgeous, tactile and meticulously lit. Balanced usable website hierarchy.
